page.layout: Two printed pages on the scan. Left page: running head at top, then a continuation paragraph, a centred heading with subtitle, and a bracketed diagram (outline) filling the page below it. Right page: only its left edge is visible, with cut-off lines of text and an ornament at the top, which is not transcribed. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: uiduus, est 60, quam ob causam is numerus Astronomis in scrupulorum numeratione tantopere placuit.
main_text.head: CAPVT VIII.
De numeratione partium Accidentali, quam Reductionem vulgò appellant.
main_text.l: CAP. VIII. Accidentalis, & dicitur Reductio, ea&q; uel partium ad

page.notes: The right page is cut off at the scan edge; its lines are only fragments of the line ends and are copied as far as visible. The diagram is transcribed as an outline with levels read from the brackets. The "=" marks in the diagram are printed hyphens at word breaks, rendered here as hyphens. The page number and the top of the ornament on the right page are not legible enough to transcribe.
